catalog.name: MenteE-Mart Data Catalog
catalog.description: Comprehensive data structure for the e-commerce platform

categories.description: Product categories with subcategories and metadata

stores.description: Store information including contact details and social media
stores.purpose: Manage store profiles and vendor information

locations.description: Geographic locations including cities and regions

attributes.description: Product attributes like sizes, colors, materials, and styles

promotions.description: Active promotions, discounts, and special offers
promotions.purpose: Manage marketing campaigns and customer incentives

search.description: Search-related data including tags, popular searches, and filter options
search.purpose: Enhance search functionality and user experience

config.description: Application configuration including UI settings and API endpoints

usage.import: Import specific catalogs: import { categories, stores } from '@/data/catalog/categories.json'
usage.organization: Each file is self-contained with metadata and versioning
usage.extension: Easy to add new catalog types following the established pattern
usage.validation: Each file includes lastUpdated timestamp and version for data integrity

legacy.description: Original data files maintained for backward compatibility

files.migration: Use for product data reference (consider migrating to database)

recommendations.2: Implement data validation using JSON Schema
